shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving worked on a broad flat face
motifs stacked vertically one above another on the shaft
subject photographed standing upright, viewed slightly from below
justification: Both are tall freestanding stone shafts bearing shallow relief motifs arranged in a vertical stack on one broad face, which gives a generic compositional echo. But the content and handling differ sharply: A shows outlined naturalistic animal figures cut in crisp low relief on pale, smooth stone in an excavation trench, while B is a dark, heavily weathered anthropomorphic block with a carved head and rounded abstract/curvilinear motifs including a prominent disc, displayed indoors.
